New tools and features land daily and I can't read them all. A Grok Bot scores each against my goals: Keep, Park or Kill. Quiet unless something clears the bar. Parked items get a revisit date; killed ones stay dead. https://t.co/VwX3tG4hDy https://t.co/MPyNFOoxi3
